name: Okamoto Kazuo
source:
Hated and despised by everyone. This pervert loser enjoys his everyday life while being delusional and masturbating to his longing idol Kirika, whom he fell in love with at first sight after watching her championship fight debut. To chase after his idol, he studied until exhausted just to enroll in the same school as her. 

His dream is shattered after knowing she gets along with her childhood friend, whom she treasures than anything else. However, just because he is protagonist in a Netori game, the plot armor grants him the rights to be the only salvation of Kirika's sickly childhood friend. Now the despicable bastard can use this to threaten the poor martial art champion as much as he wants to make all of his dark fantasies reality.
